about.lead: I’m Peter, a coach who believes strength is about far more than the number on the bar.
about.text: My job is to make training clear, motivating and sustainable. Whether you’re new to the gym or chasing your next milestone, we’ll build the confidence and capability to keep progressing.
about.quote: The best programme is one that challenges you, and still fits your real life.

steps.title: Talk
steps.text: We start with a relaxed intake about you, your training history and what you want to achieve.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: You get a focused programme built around your goals, schedule and starting point.

steps.title: Progress
steps.text: Train with coaching, track what matters and keep adapting as you get stronger.

gym.text: A friendly, specialist gym where everyone can train seriously without taking themselves too seriously.

finalCta.text: Come in, meet Peter and discover a smarter way to train. Your first conversation is free.
